question: Should CodexBar adopt any behavior from Quotio’s July 2026 quota-display fixes, and should the monitor persist reviewed Quotio SHAs?
rationale: Current CodexBar releases already contain related cadence and duplicate-window handling, but repository intent is needed to classify the remaining differences as useful, redundant, or intentionally out of scope.

options.title: Review and record dispositions
options.body: Compare both substantive commits with current CodexBar behavior, adopt only missing behavior, and persist reviewed SHAs before closing the queue item.

options.title: Mark changes inapplicable
options.body: Document that CodexBar’s existing quota architecture covers the relevant behavior and suppress these Quotio SHAs without code changes.

options.title: Keep the rolling queue
options.body: Retain the seven-day rolling report and manually reconsider repeated commits on subsequent workflow runs.

recommendation.title: Review and record dispositions
recommendation.body: Compare both substantive commits with current CodexBar behavior, adopt only missing behavior, and persist reviewed SHAs before closing the queue item.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice combines CodexBar architecture, cross-project feature intake, and workflow policy.
